summary: Two cross-country skiers overdue on a Snowmass Village to West Buttermilk trip on the Government Trail; found uninjured by Mountain Rescue Aspen the same night after their pickup ride called dispatch over the cold.
location: Government Trail, Snowmass Village to West Buttermilk parking lot
responding_agency: Pitkin County Sheriff's Office; Mountain Rescue Aspen
notes: 7 MRA members responded; 3-person foot team + 2-person snowmobile team; skiers assisted safely to parking lot ~11:42 PM.
